label: 🗺 Boundary by US state
description: Look up the WKB MULTIPOLYGON boundary of a US state from a state code (USPS or FIPS), full name, or lat/lon point. Output is ready to pipe into export_to_map (mode=choropleth).

input_mode.label: Input mode
enumLabels: text · USPS / FIPS / state name column
auto · try text first, fall back to point

input_column.label: State column
input_column.help: Column with a USPS 2-letter code (e.g. CA), a 2-digit FIPS code (06), or the state name (California). Case-insensitive.

output_column.label: Output column name
output_column.help: Name of the WKB geometry column added to the output. Companion columns are <name>_name, <name>_code (USPS), <name>_fips, <name>_centroid_lat, <name>_centroid_lon.
